content.text:
No, la autoría no tiene nada que ver. Y Entire **sí está guardando** las conversaciones en este repo.

**Cómo enlaza Entire las sesiones:** no mira quién es el autor del commit. El hook `prepare-commit-msg` añade un trailer `Entire-Checkpoint: <id>` al mensaje, y `post-commit` guarda la sesión en un ref `refs/entire/checkpoints/...`. Que el autor seas tú, o que haya o no un `Co-Authored-By`, da igual.

**Lo que hay en el repo:**
- Los 4 commits más recientes tienen su trailer `Entire-Checkpoint`. Esto incluye `8ff0814` y `4315d15`, que no llevan `Co-Authored-By`.
- Esos 4 checkpoints están como refs locales y **también en `origin`**, porque el hook `pre-push` los sube junto con tu código.
- `entire status` muestra las sesiones activas (esta de Claude Code y varias de Codex).

**Por qué los commits más antiguos no tienen checkpoint:** de `912a1fe` hacia atrás no hay trailer. `.entire/settings.json` se creó hoy a las 08:25, así que esos commits casi seguro son de antes de activar Entire. No los registra de forma retroactiva.

**Hay un aviso:** `entire status` dice `Claude Code hooks out of date · run 'entire doctor'`. Por ahora funciona, pero conviene ejecutarlo para que no se pierdan capturas tras una actualización del CLI:

```
! entire doctor
```

Si hay alguna conversación concreta que esperabas encontrar y no aparece, dime en qué commit o en qué momento fue y la busco.

Attach an existing agent session that wasn't captured by hooks.

This creates a checkpoint from the session's transcript and links it to the
last commit, or to the commit named by --commit. Use this when hooks failed
to fire or weren't installed when the session started, or to attach a
research session.

How the session is linked follows from two facts about the commit — does it
already have a checkpoint, and is it pushed — the same for HEAD and --commit:
  - It already has a checkpoint: the session is added to it. Git history is
    not changed.
  - It is already pushed: the commit is left unchanged and the link is
    recorded in a new checkpoint, which is pushed right away. The link counts
    once the commit's author attaches it, and names that exact commit: after
    a rebase or amend, attach the session to the new commit.
  - It isn't pushed: the Entire-Checkpoint trailer is added to it, which
    rewrites it and any commits after it on the current branch (their content
    is unchanged). A trailer survives a later rebase. Merges after the commit,
    or a rebase or merge in progress, are refused. If a remote can't be
    reached to confirm the commit isn't pushed, attach refuses rather than
    risk rewriting a shared commit.

attach prints what it is about to do and asks before doing it. Without a
terminal (an agent or a script) it changes nothing and exits non-zero; show
the user what it printed, and once they agree, rerun with --force.

A session can be attached to more than one commit. Each checkpoint records the
turns since the session's previous checkpoint.

Use --review to tag the attached session as an agent review. The
first user prompt in the transcript is recorded as the review prompt.
Pass --skills to declare which skills were actually run; omit to
attach a review without a declared skills list.

Works with any registered agent, including external agents enabled via
external_agents in .entire/settings.local.json (that file only, and only
when it is untracked). Run 'entire agent list' to see the full list.

If --agent doesn't locate a transcript, Entire auto-detects the agent from
the transcript and prints the detected agent name.

kamal_ui (repo kengallego/kamal-web, private), Entire CLI session capture, 2026-10-16:
- The user asked whether Entire wasn't saving AI conversations because they appear as the sole commit author. Answer: no. Entire links sessions through the `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer (prepare-commit-msg hook) and refs `refs/entire/checkpoints/*` pushed to origin by pre-push. The commit author doesn't matter.
- Root cause of the missing history: Entire was enabled on 2026-10-16 at 08:25 and only captures sessions started after that. The two big earlier Codex sessions were launched from the parent folder ~/Developer/Personal, not the repo, so Entire never associated them. The user is also not logged in to Entire (`entire login`), which may be why nothing shows on the web.
- Only commits bbb12fd..8ff0814 (4) have checkpoints. The 18 earlier commits have none; their dates were backdated by hand to Oct 14-15.
- Fixed: ran `entire doctor` and `entire agent add claude-code` (hooks were out of date and had no timeouts). This left .claude/settings.json modified and UNCOMMITTED, waiting for the user's decision.
- PENDING (awaiting user OK): attach uncaptured Codex sessions with `entire session attach <id> --agent codex --commit <sha> --force`. The commits are already pushed, so history is not rewritten: a new checkpoint is created and pushed right away. Proposed mapping: 01a13d0c-948d-74d1-bb51-1c6649de99ba (rails new → Kamal Web rename, i18n) → 34b404c; 01a13fc5-f544-7362-a397-5b2500e2e2d4 (Fly-style redesign, theme toggle, created all the commits) → 912a1fe; 01a14372-94dd-7812-bcda-6fe2b0fc4de3 → 4315d15. Skip fec02079 (only a /clear).
